Name: Cider Press (PFM)
Author: starmops
Description:
What this mod does

This mod adds a cider press machine and a variety of different cider products that you can brew from fruits. JSON Assets and the Producer Framework Mod are required. The ciders are about the same value and take the same time to brew as beers in a keg, so it's an alternative to wine for impatient farmers. Each villager has a few favorite flavors!

The press will show up in your Crafting menu and costs 35 wood + 1 iron bar to make.

Vanilla flavors:
- Apple
- Apricot
- Blackberry (3 berries needed)
- Cactus Fruit
- Cherry
- Forest Cider (3 Strawberries + 3 Blueberries)
- Orchard Cider (Grape + Apple)
- Peach
- Pomegranate
- Spiceberry
- Starfruit

PPJA Fruits and Veggies / More Trees flavors (Optional):
- Asian Pear
- Elderberry
- Gooseberry
- Green Apple
- Pear
- Rhubarb
- Spiced Apple Cider (Cinnamon + Apple)
- Spiced Citrus Cider (Orange + Cinnamon)
- Summer Cider (Passionfruit + Pineapple)
- Lemon Ale (Lemon + Wheat)
- Lime Ale (Lime + Wheat)
- Grapefruit Ale (Grapefruit + Wheat)
- Yuzu Ale (Yuzu + Wheat)
- Orange Ale (Orange + Wheat)

Compatibility Notes

This mod adds cider products as JSON Assets. It may not be compatible with other mods that add JSON Assets if the objects have the same name.
